title: AMD to Acquire AI Hardware Startup Taalas for $2.9B
summary: A deal was reached in August for the purchase of Taalas Inc., a developer of hardware designed for artificial intelligence inference. The semiconductor firm will acquire the startup for $2.9 billion, a total that include about $1.4 billion in contingent consideration.
